items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: And that's what Al Hertz Band needs. They need to learn how to play as a group, not as individuals.

ctx.x: They were totally lacking in the way of an organized sound, you know, and just a little touch of refinement or a little touch of know-how in regarding to playing as a group. And that's what Al Hertz Band needs. They need to learn how to play as a group, not as individuals. But as individuals, brother, there's about five of them that are great. And of course, that takes in Al Hertz. Al Hertz and that clarinet player and the, oh, the drummer that he's got. He's tremendous, man. He is some drummer, that guy.…
You talked about Vic Burton as having supported the band. Oh, yeah. He's a great drummer. Do you remember anybody else impressed you that way in your experiences?
